paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different methods in simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", is scaled linearly from 0 to 8 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", is also linearly scaled from 20 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 2. Four lines are shown, each representing a different method: "Consistency-CE" (purple dashed line with circular markers), "Inconsistency-CE" (purple dashed line with square markers), "Inconsistency-CE-MP" (blue dashed line with square markers), and "Consistency-Bi" (red solid line with star markers). The "Consistency-Bi" line starts at approximately BLEU 22.5 at AL=2 and increases steadily to about 30 at AL=8. The "Inconsistency-CE" line begins at around BLEU 22 at AL=2 and rises to approximately 29.5 at AL=8. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line starts at BLEU 22 at AL=2 and increases to about 29 at AL=8. The "Consistency-CE" line begins at BLEU 20 at AL=2 and rises to approximately 28 at AL=8. All lines show an upward trend as AL increases, with "Consistency-Bi" consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across all AL values.
